title.zh: MetaMask Exits Lido Validators Amid Infrastructure ‘Security Incident’
title.en: MetaMask Exits Lido Validators Amid Infrastructure ‘Security Incident’

current_state.zh: MetaMask is responding to an ongoing security incident affecting part of its infrastructure and is precautionarily exiting the Ethereum validators it operates in the Lido staking protocol, while Lido says stETH holders need take no action and that returned ETH may take up to 45 days.
current_state.en: MetaMask is responding to an ongoing security incident affecting part of its infrastructure and is precautionarily exiting the Ethereum validators it operates in the Lido staking protocol, while Lido says stETH holders need take no action and that returned ETH may take up to 45 days.
